evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說文釋形 / 釋義 / 形體資料表
evidence.text: The entry gives two received Shuowen versions: “助也。从口，从又” and “手口相助也。从又，从口.” It records assistance, directional, west, rank, and modern political senses, while its paleographic collection illustrations are marked unavailable in the public view. This establishes textual variation and recorded senses, not original formation or sense chronology.
evidence.title: A00483 右 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: 說文解字 / 說文解字注 / 字源字形
evidence.text: The opened entry records the received Shuowen formulations with differing component orders and a Duan commentary questioning the received explanation. It catalogs an oracle-bone specimen 鐵7.4 合20836, early Western Zhou bronze examples, manuscript collections, seal script and later forms. Its catalog does not date the cited oracle specimen or establish the proposed transition sequence. The page records help, direction, rank, and banquet use read as 侑, without proving their order or semantic links.
evidence.title: 右 yòu - 汉典

evidence.source: Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction supplementary-materials page
evidence.text: The authors describe the downloadable materials as supplementary to Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction (2014), including nearly 5,000 reconstructed items. The page confirms the dataset exists but does not itself establish the exact 又 or 右 readings. The local Baxter–Sagart rows supplied with this task give 又: MC hjuwH, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s, gloss “also, in addition”; 右: MC hjuwX, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ, and MC hjuwH, OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s (~ *m-qʷəʔ), gloss “right hand.” These local readings permit comparison but do not prove a phonetic role or whole-graph loan.
evidence.title: The Baxter-Sagart reconstruction of Old Chinese

search_audit.query: 右 甲骨文 字形演变 右 又 口 字源 说文 手口相助
search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced official dictionary pages and competing accounts. Opened the Taiwan Ministry of Education entry and ZDIC and inspected their text and form catalogues. The entries preserve competing interpretations and do not establish a dated formation sequence or earliest sense.

Search found a big-seal candidate. Opening that exact page returned a cache miss. The exact local-manifest seal-file page and official MediaWiki imageinfo API URL were also attempted; both failed to open. No candidate's current source metadata or image was verified.

Attempted character-specific official Unihan URLs for 右, 又 and 口. All failed to open. Local kMandarin rows supplied in the task report yòu, yòu and kǒu respectively; these remain local readings, not independently verified external records.

search_audit.query: site:ocbaxtersagart.lsait.lsa.umich.edu 右 又 Baxter Sagart 2014
search_audit.outcome: Opened the authors’ official supplementary-materials page. It confirms the 2014 reconstruction materials and downloadable tables, but the exact downloadable rows were not opened. Local table readings are reported as local data only.

gaps: The graph's original formation remains disputed: the received Shuowen hand-and-mouth account, a ritual-vessel interpretation, and the proposal that 口 was added as a differentiating mark are not resolved by an inspected primary paleographic witness.
No securely dated earliest Chinese inscriptional attestation or semantic use was verified. Catalogued inscription labels and dictionary glosses do not establish chronology.
The sequence and semantic links among direction, assistance, blessing, west, rank and the banquet use read as 侑 remain unresolved.
The exact Shuowen textual history and possible corruption remain unresolved; the opened sources document variant wording but no critical manuscript witness was inspected.
Official Unihan pages for 右, 又 and 口 were inaccessible. Their local kMandarin values are yòu, yòu and kǒu, respectively, and are not asserted as externally authenticated.

The exact Baxter–Sagart downloadable table rows were not externally opened. Supplied local rows preserve the dataset notation: 又 MC hjuwH / OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s; 右 MC hjuwX / OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ and MC hjuwH / OC *[ɢ]ʷəʔ-s (~ *m-qʷəʔ). They do not independently establish component role.

No external evidence inspected here establishes 又 as a phonetic component inside 右. A whole-graph borrowing proposal would also require independently supported evidence for the original referent's name and sound; that evidence was not found.

No suitable image is proposed. The exact Commons candidates could not be verified through an opened description page and original-image link, and the official paleographic dictionary's illustrations were unavailable. A local file or manifest lead does not establish identity or current reuse terms.
No bulk reuse terms were verified for the repeated dictionary sources; no local extract is recommended.

limitations.text: No usable historical glyph image was established in this run. Exact Commons page/image verification failed, while the opened Taiwan Ministry of Education entry marks its oracle-bone and bronze form illustrations unavailable. The rival formation proposals therefore remain unillustrated here.
